auditor_value: 0 ≤ F ≤ 5 N: f = F, a = 0. F > 5 N: f = μₖmg = 4 N constant, a = (F − 4) m/s² (jumps to 1 m/s² just past F = 5 N)

findings.quote: so any extra force beyond 4 N goes straight into accelerating the block
findings.note: Figurative phrasing ('goes straight into'); the plain statement is that the net force F − 4 N produces the acceleration.
findings.fix: so the net force F − 4 N produces the acceleration of the block.

notes: Independently: f_max = 0.5 × 10 = 5 N, kinetic f = 0.4 × 10 = 4 N, a = F − 4 for F > 5 N. Every printed equation is correct and both mistake entries are genuine errors.
